name: Maggie Appleton
role: Designer · digital garden · tools for thought
bio: Maggie Appleton maintains maggieappleton.com as a digital garden of essays and notes on design, anthropomorphism, and tools for thought. Public work includes design engineering and illustrated essays that treat interfaces as cultural artifacts. She is often cited for making complex product and AI ideas visually legible without buzzword gloss.
